tasks.name: spdx-check
args: & { $marker = 'SPDX-License-Identifier: EUPL-1.2'; $missing = 0; Get-ChildItem -Path src,tests -Include '*.cs','*.razor' -Recurse -File | Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch '[\\/](obj|bin|Migrations)[\\/]' } | ForEach-Object { $head = Get-Content $_.FullName -TotalCount 5 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (-not ($head -match [regex]::Escape($marker))) { Write-Host "Missing SPDX: $($_.FullName)"; $missing++ } }; if ($missing -gt 0) { Write-Error "$missing file(s) missing SPDX header. Run: pwsh scripts/add-spdx-header.ps1"; exit 1 } }

tasks.name: credential-ban
args: & { $files = @('src/Aetheus.Back/appsettings.json', 'src/Aetheus.Back/appsettings.Development.json'); $bad = 0; foreach ($f in $files) { if (Test-Path $f) { $json = Get-Content $f -Raw; if ($json -match '"(Password|Secret|Key|Token)"\s*:\s*"(?!\s*")[^"]+"') { Write-Host "Credential detected in $f"; $bad++ } } }; if ($bad -gt 0) { Write-Error 'Potential credentials in appsettings - remove before committing'; exit 1 } }
